item.title: How a pair of red shoelaces and IU football brought a couple together
item.description: IU football fans Karen and John Gerni reflect on how the Hoosiers brought them together and how they have continued to bond over the team, even making the nine-hour drive to catch games at Memorial Stadium.

item.title: Safety concern prompts Evenflo recall of All4One car seats
item.description: Evenflo is recalling certain All4One four-in-one convertible car seats manufactured between January 2022 and June 2024 due to potential safety issues with the recline mechanism. Affected families will be offered an equivalent replacement car seat at no cost.

item.title: Police: Anderson mom who fatally shot daughter was drunk, thought ex-husband was breaking in
item.description: Tia Holmes, 38, faces charges of reckless homicide, neglect of a dependent, and neglect of a dependent resulting in serious bodily injury after fatally shooting her 17-year-old daughter Tianna Harris, whom she mistook for an intruder.

item.title: ICE agent’s cellphone captures fatal confrontation in Minneapolis
item.description: Video footage released by CNN shows the moments leading up to the fatal shooting of Renee Good by ICE agent Jonathan Ross, with Vice President JD Vance claiming the agent was endangered and fired in self-defense.

item.title: On-duty Mooresville officer hits, kills pedestrian; investigation underway
item.description: An on-duty Mooresville police officer fatally struck a pedestrian standing in the road late Friday night, and both the Morgan County Serious Crash Investigations Team and Mooresville PD are conducting investigations.

item.title: Cooler weekend finish then a thaw next week | Jan. 10, 2026
item.description: The weekend will be cold and blustery with a few snow showers, followed by a thaw on Monday and Tuesday with highs climbing into the 40s and near 50, before a cool down late Wednesday with a few flurries or light snow possible.

item.title: Frontier adds flights to Miami for IU fans going to championship game
item.description: Frontier Airlines is adding flights from Indianapolis to Miami for the College Football Playoff National Championship, with departures on Jan. 17 and 18 and return flights on Jan. 20.

item.title: IU takes down Oregon, advances to national championship
item.description: IU beat Oregon 56-22 to win the Peach Bowl and advance to the national championship, with quarterback Fernando Mendoza leading the way with 177 yards and five touchdowns.
